activation: Deferred until the coordinator grants the catalog/delivery slot; no successor version chosen.
supported_modes: Prepared pure typed helpers for reviewed ARM/REST 2024-05-01 and AzureRM 4.50.0 literal values. Full raw/plan/ARM/saved/injected normalization, review, tier, output and replay integration awaits the merged predecessor gateway/connection contract.
shared_interface_needs: Reuse cohort13 gateway SKU, gatewayType, activeActive, enableBgp, public-IP/subnet relationships and connection circuit/local-network-gateway relationships.
Reuse original-time and scoped evidence guards. Add only explicit FastPath booleans to the merged connection projection.
ARM ErGwScale autoscale bounds can support a minimum-scale subcheck; pinned Terraform documentation exposes no corresponding field.
Preserve routing_evidence connection/IPsec/MACsec and identity_evidence Direct-port identity meanings; no alternate gateway abstraction.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared explicit circuit tier/family and separate provider Mbps/Direct Gbps facts; no billing default or cost threshold.
evidence_requirements: Bind a representative original-time outbound demand record to the exact circuit, billing period, peering pricing zone and negotiated price currency.
Compare actual metered/unlimited circuit, gateway, provider, Direct-port and Global Reach costs; Local's included unlimited transfer is a different case.
Reviewer decision: does the attributable demand and total-cost comparison justify this circuit's unlimited-data plan?
recommendations.limitations: MeteredData or Local is not a generic pass; configured bandwidth is not outbound volume, demand or break-even economics. No live billing/traffic read or pricing API.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared explicit circuit tier, minimised peering-location presence and typed Direct port binding; location presence is not Local eligibility.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile each actual physical peering location with the source-reviewed Local mapping for all required Azure workload and recovery regions; circuit resource location is not the peering location.
Resolve scoped connection/circuit/gateway bindings and unsupported Global Reach or wider-geography requirements.
Reviewer decision: does Local support every required region/service and provide the justified cost alternative for this exact circuit?
recommendations.limitations: Local SKU, circuit region, one relationship or a public table cannot establish current regional availability, port admission, complete target regions or cost suitability.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Reviewed exact AZ-capable SKUs including ErGwScale; gateway placement facts deliberately await merged cohort13 helpers.
evidence_requirements: Bind an ExpressRoute gateway to its actual supported region, exact SKU, deployed/migrated configuration and public-IP allocation/zone evidence.
Distinguish AZ-capable from zonal versus zone-redundant placement and new auto-assigned public-IP behavior from existing deployments.
Reviewer decision: does attributable deployment evidence establish zone-redundant ExpressRoute gateway placement in the required supported region?
recommendations.limitations: An AZ substring misses ErGwScale and can classify a zonal AZ-capable gateway incorrectly. No live availability, health, public-IP detail or migration operation.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared explicit Direct-port bandwidth/encapsulation and circuit Gbps plus typed binding, without using resource presence as demand.
evidence_requirements: Supply approved aggregate/per-flow throughput, burst, latency and dedicated-port requirements with attributable measurements and growth assumptions.
Reconcile provider circuit limits, actual Direct port/circuit allocation, gateway/fallback capacity and equipment/colocation readiness.
Reviewer decision: does demand above 10 Gbps or the dedicated-port requirement justify the supported Direct design, including conditional 400-Gbps location/enrollment when relevant?
recommendations.limitations: The checklist's trigger is a requirement, not configured capacity or achieved throughput. The current Direct page documents conditional 400 Gbps beyond older FAQ/CAF 10/100 text.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared strict independent gateway-bypass and Private Link FastPath booleans, not runtime path or eligibility verdicts.
evidence_requirements: Bind explicit low-latency or >10-Gbps throughput demand to the exact ExpressRoute connection and gateway.
Verify UltraPerformance/ErGw3AZ or ARM ErGwScale minimum ten scale units; no Terraform scale default/block is inferred. Virtual WAN Direct five-unit defaults are a separate unsupported model.
Review Direct/provider, IPv4/IPv6, same-region hub/spoke, UDR, service, enrolled limited-GA Private Link and cumulative port IP limits separately; reconcile supported fallback gateway capacity.
Reviewer decision: is FastPath enabled and eligible for the exact demanded traffic/topology, with attributable path/performance evidence rather than only bypass=true?
recommendations.limitations: Provider IPv4 hub support is narrower than Direct. Private Link is limited GA with enrollment/region/service limits. Exhaustion and unsupported/cross-region traffic fall back through the gateway.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Reviewed supported VPN gateway/public-IP prerequisites; placement integration awaits predecessor facts, without an AZ-name predicate.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile VPN gateway type/SKU, supported region and original deployment or migration against current service guidance.
Verify every applicable Standard public IP's actual zone-redundant placement; active-active and zone redundancy are separate.
Reviewer decision: is this branch/remote VPN gateway actually deployed zone redundantly in a supported region?
recommendations.limitations: SKU text does not prove public-IP zones or gateway VM placement. New default behavior is not evidence that an existing gateway was migrated.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Reviewed appliance-specific binding/failure-domain questions; no count inferred from Azure activeActive or local-gateway records.
evidence_requirements: Reconcile each branch/site's real independent VPN appliances, active-active or active-passive arrangement and power/uplink/failure domains using redacted attributable inventory.
Bind supplied Azure IPsec connections/local-gateway declarations to actual appliances; two tunnels can terminate on one device. Review appropriate BGP/ECMP, route withdrawal and failover evidence.
Reviewer decision: are redundant on-premises appliances deployed and configured to preserve this site's connectivity during an appliance/path failure?
recommendations.limitations: Azure activeActive, two local gateway IDs or multiple connections cannot attest on-premises appliance population/independence/health. No IPs, keys, topology probes or live appliance inventory.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared Direct binding, circuit tier/family and port billing facts to separate port and Local circuit economics.
evidence_requirements: Resolve the exact Direct port/circuit relationship and all required local/nonlocal regions and services against current Local mapping.
Compare negotiated port billing, Local/Standard/Premium circuit charges, outbound transfer, gateway and colocation/provider costs for attributable actual usage.
Reviewer decision: has the Local circuit alternative on this Direct port been considered and accepted or rejected with a source-bound regional and full-cost rationale?
recommendations.limitations: Port billing and circuit family are different fields. Direct+Local presence does not prove lower total cost or suitability, and Local cannot supply Global Reach.

recommendations.implemented_subclaim: Prepared circuit-to-Direct-port binding, capacity and QinQ/Dot1Q context, not inferred environment labels or effective routing-domain isolation.
evidence_requirements: Supply the accountable owner's explicit separation/dedicated-bandwidth requirements and exact accepted production/nonproduction routing populations; never infer them from names or tags.
Reconcile actual separate circuit bindings, VLAN/VRF and on-premises BGP/route import/export, VNet interconnections, Global Reach and bypass paths.
Account for shared Direct port/provider capacity, rate limits and noisy-neighbor demand; two circuit declarations are not independent physical bandwidth.
Reviewer decision: does the implemented dedicated-circuit/routing design satisfy the explicit isolation/capacity requirement with attributable operational evidence?
recommendations.limitations: QinQ/Dot1Q, circuit count, distinct IDs and rate-limit intent are bounded configuration facts only. No addresses, route/packet probes, isolation testing or environment-name inference.
